summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of CHESS learning platform. All 30 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend testing confirmed all core features working: home page with interactive hero board, navbar with global search, 14 openings with detail pages and XP rewards, 16 lessons with interactive lesson player and move validation, 12 tactics with trainer feedback, daily puzzle, progress dashboard with gamification (XP, levels, streaks, achievements), and sandbox board with full interactivity. Click-to-move board interaction verified across all interactive boards. Anonymous per-device progress via X-Client-Id working correctly.
